Ashen Wyrm

Huge dragon, neutral evil

Armor Class 18 (natural armor)

Hit Points 184 (16d12 + 80)

Speed 40 ft., burrow 30 ft., fly 80 ft.

STR
25 (+7)
DEX
10 (+0)
CON
21 (+5)
INT
14 (+2)
WIS
13 (+1)
CHA
17 (+3)

Saving Throws Dex +5, Con +10, Wis +6, Cha +8

Skills Perception +11, Stealth +5

Damage Resistances bludgeoning from non-magical attacks

Damage Immunities fire

Condition Immunities exhaustion

Senses blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 21

Languages Common, Draconic

Challenge 14 (11500 XP)   Proficiency Bonus +5

Legendary Resistance (3/Day)If the wyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Ash CloakWhile in ash or smoke, the wyrm is heavily obscured to creatures that rely on sight.

Actions

MultiattackThe wyrm makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

BiteMelee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) fire damage.

ClawMelee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

Ash Breath (Recharge 5–6)The wyrm exhales burning ash in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 49 (14d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one, and is blinded until the end of its next turn on a failed save.

Legendary Actions

The wyrm can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The wyrm regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

DetectThe wyrm makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

Tail SweepMelee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

Smother (Costs 2 Actions)Ash swirls in a 20-foot-radius sphere centred on a point the wyrm can see within 90 feet. Each creature in the sphere must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be unable to breathe until the end of its next turn.

Lair Actions

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the wyrm takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; the wyrm can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

Cinder FallGlowing cinders rain in a 20-foot-radius cylinder the wyrm can see within 120 feet. Each creature in it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

CollapsePart of the ceiling gives way over a point the wyrm can see within 120 feet. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

Regional Effects

The region within 6 miles of an ashen wyrm's lair is warped by its presence, which creates one or more of the following effects:

Grey SnowFine ash falls from a clear sky once a day, coating everything and hiding tracks.

Dead WellsWater within 1 mile of the lair tastes of soot and puts out no fire.
